026b420d703e.en: Itanema asks, seemingly out of nowhere, but with a decent amount of backstory behind it: "Sora, don't you want to go home to your parents?" Sora shies away and hugs her pillow. "Running from it all again… It's not working, is it?" Aurora sits by Sora and rests Sora's head on her breasts. "C'mon, Itanema, leave her alone. Sora, no rush." "No rush? Are we planning to live like we're in cooking and accounting school for the rest of our lives?" "It's not so bad. I do feel pretty safe." Itanema disagrees, but says nothing. A knock on the door.
026b420d703e.t: Itanema bertanya, seolah-olah entah dari mana, tetapi dengan latar cerita yang agak banyak di sebaliknya: “Sora, kau tak nak balik kepada mak ayah kau ke?” Sora mengelak dan memeluk bantalnya. “Lari daripada semuanya lagi… Tak berkesan, kan?” Aurora duduk di sebelah Sora dan menyandarkan kepala Sora di dadanya. “Sudahlah, Itanema, jangan kacau dia. Sora, tak perlu tergesa-gesa.” “Tak perlu tergesa-gesa? Kita nak hidup macam kita di sekolah masakan dan perakaunan seumur hidup ke?” “Tak teruk sangat. Aku rasa agak selamat.” Itanema tidak setuju, tetapi tidak berkata apa-apa. Ketukan di pintu.

0376d412f4aa.en: Kibe and his guard captains go through their daily work
0376d412f4aa.t: Kibe dan kapten pengawalnya menjalankan kerja harian mereka

037814020734.en: "Just—just one more thing. I'm nominating Kibe as my apprentice." Kibe, walking off in the distance, thinks his ears just stopped working. "Kibe is exceptional at following specific directions, so he'd be my perfect right hand. On which note, I'll also officially introduce a vote to rename the position." The crowd stares at Kibe. "What?" Huneo smiles: "Pay will be the same as an apprentice's." Kibe shudders.
037814020734.t: “Cuma—cuma satu perkara lagi. Saya mencalonkan Kibe sebagai perantis saya.” Kibe, yang sedang berjalan pergi di kejauhan, menyangka telinganya baru berhenti berfungsi. “Kibe sangat cemerlang mengikut arahan khusus, jadi dia akan jadi tangan kanan saya yang sempurna. Berkenaan itu, saya juga akan secara rasmi memperkenalkan undian untuk menamakan semula jawatan itu.” Orang ramai merenung Kibe. “Apa?” Huneo tersenyum: “Gajinya sama seperti gaji perantis.” Kibe menggigil.

04ffd1cf0e22.en: (Art note: maybe add a Wozen nari gel mix to her: make it cute, but show the Magina man is into weird kinks.)
04ffd1cf0e22.t: (Nota seni: mungkin tambah campuran nari gel Wozen padanya: buat dia comel, tapi tunjukkan lelaki Magina itu suka fetish pelik.)

0652ae8104e9.en: Morika has finished burying Gabiro's research. Posaqui: "Yessu! I laid a total of thirty-five misdirections for the adventurers." Namia: three adventurers stumbled onto where Sinoi was held captive, but found nothing new.
0652ae8104e9.t: Morika sudah selesai menanam penyelidikan Gabiro. Posaqui: “Yessu! Aku dah pasang sejumlah tiga puluh lima jejak palsu untuk pengembara.” Namia: tiga orang pengembara terjumpa tempat Sinoi ditawan, tetapi tidak menjumpai apa-apa yang baharu.

08b6c4d64fd9.en: Silent tears pour down Katsuki's face as her hands calm down. "One. Trust broken. Two. No sister."
08b6c4d64fd9.t: Air mata senyap mengalir di wajah Katsuki ketika tangannya tenang. “Satu. Kepercayaan hancur. Dua. Bukan kakak.”

0a59d5cae6b5.en: Morika comes in to feed her; she gets aggressive, and it turns violent. He knocks her out. Nobody can really deal with her, so they pour Black Honey down her throat.
0a59d5cae6b5.t: Morika masuk untuk memberinya makan; dia menjadi agresif, dan keadaan bertukar ganas. Lelaki itu memengsankannya. Tiada siapa betul-betul boleh menanganinya, jadi mereka menuang Black Honey ke dalam kerongkongnya.

0c1217744332.en: A sinking feeling sets in, getting worse with every step: thick saliva, a clenched throat, a turning stomach. He holds onto a tree and pukes his guts out, weaker than before, then wanders on, aimless, under graying skies.
0c1217744332.t: Rasa tenggelam mula datang, semakin teruk dengan setiap langkah: air liur pekat, tekak tercekik, perut memulas. Dia berpaut pada sebatang pokok dan muntah sepuas-puasnya, lebih lemah daripada sebelumnya, kemudian merayau lagi, tanpa tujuan, di bawah langit yang semakin kelabu.

108ec496671e.en: Forest all around. What should I do? Where do I go? He sees the sisters again in his mind, and remembers the moment Katsumi kicked him out.
108ec496671e.t: Hutan di sekeliling. Apa patut aku buat? Ke mana aku nak pergi? Dia nampak adik-beradik itu lagi dalam fikirannya, dan teringat saat Katsumi menghalaunya.

13758efa5b4a.en: One Bagarisa stands up, its back lit on fire. The others notice too, and get defensive.
13758efa5b4a.t: Seekor Bagarisa berdiri, belakangnya terbakar. Yang lain perasan juga, dan bersiap mempertahankan diri.

16b643973657.en: Neferteri stands and hugs her. "As Queen of Sanbi, I hereby relieve you of your research duties." Tears run down her face as the memory of a dead fetus creeps back: Eori was pregnant when Arukia killed her in Vol 3, and when Morika revived her, her body rejected and expelled the fetus. Neferteri saw the corpse of what would have been her first grandchild, and told Morika to dispose of it properly. "I'm sorry, Eori. I should have known."
16b643973657.t: Neferteri berdiri dan memeluknya. “Sebagai Permaisuri Sanbi, beta dengan ini melepaskan anakanda daripada tugas penyelidikan.” Air mata mengalir di wajahnya ketika ingatan tentang janin yang mati menjalar kembali: Eori sedang hamil ketika Arukia membunuhnya dalam Jilid 3, dan apabila Morika menghidupkannya semula, badannya menolak dan mengeluarkan janin itu. Neferteri melihat mayat yang sepatutnya menjadi cucu pertamanya, dan menyuruh Morika menguruskannya dengan sewajarnya. “Maafkan bonda, Eori. Bonda sepatutnya tahu.”

183c9d45f2a2.en: "All right! FINE! SUIT YOURSELF!" Katsumi runs, biting her lips in anger, but her sister's face keeps haunting her. She trips into the mud, too weak to get up, and feels something sharp poke her back.
183c9d45f2a2.t: “Baiklah! OKEY! IKUT SUKA KAU!” Katsumi berlari, menggigit bibirnya kerana marah, tetapi wajah adiknya terus menghantuinya. Dia tersadung ke dalam lumpur, terlalu lemah untuk bangun, dan merasakan sesuatu yang tajam mencucuk belakangnya.

19e1fb5e6675.en: He can't move. One of the Bagarisas farts. He shakes himself loose and stands up, and realizes the fost stone lamp went out overnight.
19e1fb5e6675.t: Dia tidak boleh bergerak. Seekor Bagarisa kentut. Dia menggoncang diri hingga terlepas dan berdiri, dan sedar lampu fost stone padam semalaman.

1ba746dcb010.en: Katsumi drags Katsuki along until Katsuki pulls free and stops dead. "ONE! ENOUGH! TWO! KILL—ME!" Katsumi slaps her and pulls, but she won't budge, and walks toward the oncoming bandits.
1ba746dcb010.t: Katsumi mengheret Katsuki sehingga Katsuki melepaskan diri dan berhenti terpaku. “SATU! CUKUP! DUA! BUNUH—AKU!” Katsumi menamparnya dan menarik, tetapi dia tidak berganjak, dan berjalan ke arah penyamun yang datang.

1d64c561b188.en: Katsumi mouths off and draws the bandits' ire. When she refuses to come work at their farm and they realize the two are Red Winga whores, they draw their swords.
1d64c561b188.t: Katsumi bercakap besar dan membangkitkan kemarahan penyamun itu. Apabila dia enggan datang bekerja di ladang mereka dan mereka sedar dua beradik itu pelacur Red Winga, mereka menghunus pedang.

1db7f1b7ba4c.en: Breathing hard, he feels the pain the adrenaline had been holding back dequeue into his mind all at once. His feet are the worst: they've been leaking blood for a while, leaving a trail that quickly blends into the sea of leaves on the chilly wind.
1db7f1b7ba4c.t: Tercungap-cungap, dia merasakan kesakitan yang ditahan adrenalin selama ini keluar dari baris gilir ke dalam mindanya serentak. Kakinya paling teruk: ia sudah lama mengalirkan darah, meninggalkan jejak yang cepat bercampur dengan lautan daun dalam angin dingin.

1e54d6d88b18.en: Harry wakes to a Bagarisa kissing him and pushes it away, screaming: they kind of stink. It oinks at him, as if complaining about the bad treatment.
1e54d6d88b18.t: Harry bangun dengan seekor Bagarisa sedang menciumnya dan menolaknya sambil menjerit: mereka agak busuk. Ia mendengus kepadanya, seolah-olah mengadu tentang layanan buruk itu.

1ef7434d628a.en: Neferteri: from now on, they'll let the quest go stale and give her daughter's heart time to heal. Their next orders: find Harry and Sinoi. All three are to go fully back to their adventurer roles and cast a wide net across the kingdom. She hands out the only badge they have, which is Harry's, and cuts their stipend in half: the new courtroom scientist is relentless about probing Eiri for spending records.
1ef7434d628a.t: Neferteri: mulai sekarang, mereka akan membiarkan misi itu basi dan memberi masa untuk hati anaknya pulih. Arahan seterusnya: cari Harry dan Sinoi. Ketiga-tiga mereka perlu kembali sepenuhnya kepada peranan pengembara dan menebar jaring luas di seluruh kerajaan. Dia menyerahkan satu-satunya lencana yang mereka ada, iaitu milik Harry, dan memotong elaun mereka separuh: saintis istana yang baharu tidak henti-henti menyiasat Eiri tentang rekod perbelanjaan.

1f83626049d8.en: Kibe: "I'm out." Someone in the crowd: "Man! You suck!" A tall, strong Darfaries: "Yeah! I'll give you an Amethyst if you can suck me as much as you sucked at this job! Hahaha!" Kibe pauses, almost as if taking a mental picture of him, before leaving the stage.
1f83626049d8.t: Kibe: “Aku blah.” Seseorang dalam orang ramai: “Weh! Kau teruk!” Seorang Darfaries yang tinggi dan kuat: “Ya! Aku bagi kau sebiji Amethyst kalau kau boleh hisap aku seteruk kau buat kerja ni! Hahaha!” Kibe berhenti sejenak, hampir seperti merakam gambarnya dalam kepala, sebelum meninggalkan pentas.

21f1d37a8f90.en: Eori shuts down. "I need to find Harry first." Maiara loses it. "All right, that's it! He was supposed to be MY husband!" "He's not!" "Yeah? Then why are you so obsessed with him?" "I AM NOT! HE'S A NO—I WANT HIM AS A RESEARCH ASSISTANT!"
21f1d37a8f90.t: Eori menutup diri. “Aku perlu cari Harry dulu.” Maiara naik angin. “Okey, cukup! Dia sepatutnya suami AKU!” “Bukan!” “Ye ke? Habis kenapa kau taksub sangat dengan dia?” “AKU TAK! DIA BU—AKU NAK DIA JADI PEMBANTU PENYELIDIKAN!”

22e8027cecaa.en: Arc #2 - Hifuna Beast: the author's story notes (spoilers).
22e8027cecaa.t: Arka #2 - Makhluk Buas Hifuna: nota cerita pengarang (bocoran).

24fff589839c.en: Sora gasps. "Then how did she have time to make all those nari gels, being that lovey-dovey?" "It's all about love—and you lost your chance, since he's not coming back for a maid." Sora turns red with shame. "Still rubs you the wrong way? Then ask him to rub you the right way." Eiri laughs, but it ends in a sad smile, remembering how she coerced Harry into signing the contract. I'm sorry, Harry. I hope you decided to flee it all instead… She has a guard escort Sora back to the dormitory: she has a few things to talk about with Eori.
24fff589839c.t: Sora tersentak. “Habis macam mana dia ada masa buat semua nari gel tu, sambil bermesra-mesraan?” “Semuanya pasal cinta—dan kau dah terlepas peluang, sebab dia takkan balik untuk seorang pembantu rumah.” Sora menjadi merah kerana malu. “Masih rasa tak kena? Minta dia belai kau dengan betul, kalau macam tu.” Eiri ketawa, tetapi ia berakhir dengan senyuman sedih, teringat bagaimana dia memaksa Harry menandatangani kontrak itu. Maafkan aku, Harry. Aku harap kau memilih untuk lari daripada semua ni… Dia menyuruh seorang pengawal mengiringi Sora balik ke asrama: dia ada beberapa perkara nak dibincangkan dengan Eori.

271769f39b6a.en: A knock: Eiri. "Hey, got time to spare?" "I'm busy." "All right, all right. I came to ask about Harry." Eori turns. "What do you want?" "So what was your relationship with him? Did you break up with him, or what?"
271769f39b6a.t: Ketukan: Eiri. “Hei, ada masa lapang?” “Aku sibuk.” “Okey, okey. Aku datang nak tanya pasal Harry.” Eori berpaling. “Kau nak apa?” “Jadi apa hubungan kau dengan dia? Kau putus dengan dia ke, atau apa?”

27883fc55be5.en: Everyone approves except Neferteri, who drills Huneo with questions. Eiri asks if she suspects him; Neferteri says it's all happening too fast.
27883fc55be5.t: Semua orang meluluskan kecuali Neferteri, yang menyoal Huneo bertubi-tubi. Eiri bertanya sama ada dia mencurigainya; Neferteri kata semuanya berlaku terlalu cepat.

2b8aec035b77.en: "See? I told ya, it's just a matter of connecting the dots. Now, Sora, can you put some sense into Eiri and stop her Big Momma behavior?" Sora still can't swallow it. "Then why didn't Arukia ever contact us?" "Why would she? I'd find it weird if she suddenly wasn't private about her life."
2b8aec035b77.t: “Nampak? Aku dah cakap, cuma soal sambungkan titik. Sekarang, Sora, boleh tak kau sedarkan Eiri dan hentikan perangai Mak Besar dia?” Sora masih tak boleh telan. “Habis kenapa Arukia tak pernah hubungi kita?” “Kenapa dia nak buat macam tu? Aku rasa pelik kalau dia tiba-tiba tak berahsia pasal hidup dia.”

2c43660cbd0f.en: "Hey, fuckface! Can't you see they're Red Winga property?" "So what? They're whores anyway!" "Red Winga whores! Can't you imagine how much info they have?" "And?" "And we can get information out of them, you retarded Brunto. Let's go! I knew I'd spotted gold."
2c43660cbd0f.t: “Hoi, muka pantat! Kau tak nampak ke mereka harta Red Winga?” “Jadi apa? Pelacur juga!” “Pelacur Red Winga! Kau tak boleh bayang ke berapa banyak maklumat yang mereka ada?” “Dan?” “Dan kita boleh korek maklumat daripada mereka, kau Brunto bebal terencat. Jom! Aku tahu aku dah jumpa emas.”

311d650285c6.en: Neferteri calmly applauds. "Thank you, Princess Nina. Based on y—" Eori feels the end of the line coming; she bursts into tears, crying like a child caught stealing candy.
311d650285c6.t: Neferteri bertepuk tangan dengan tenang. “Terima kasih, Puteri Nina. Berdasarkan a—” Eori dapat rasa penghujungnya tiba; dia meledak menangis, menangis seperti budak yang ditangkap mencuri gula-gula.

316169bc2b0f.en: Harry and the Bagarisas are getting each other's rhythm. Two Bagarisas die in the fight, and the others revive them. Harry uses the Bagarisas' exploding forward power.
316169bc2b0f.t: Harry dan Bagarisa semakin serasi rentak antara satu sama lain. Dua ekor Bagarisa mati dalam pertarungan, dan yang lain menghidupkan mereka semula. Harry menggunakan kuasa letupan ke depan Bagarisa.

32bece148f77.en: He screams, tackles a Wozen from behind, and his hand lights up, burning it alive; he kills it by burning its face and mouth.
32bece148f77.t: Dia menjerit, menerkam seekor Wozen dari belakang, dan tangannya menyala, membakarnya hidup-hidup; dia membunuhnya dengan membakar muka dan mulutnya.

33ff0bcdf78e.en: Katsuki pulls away and starts walking back. Katsumi grabs her. "Too late now! Harry's dead meat! He's not gonna survive the night."
33ff0bcdf78e.t: Katsuki menarik diri dan mula berjalan balik. Katsumi menangkapnya. “Dah terlambat! Harry dah jadi daging busuk! Dia takkan hidup sampai pagi.”

35cdee85b8e7.en: "I am the Queen of Sanbi, but above all, I'm the mother of four princesses. I trusted you with an important task despite my doubts about your ability to care for others. But your inability to control your emotions turned out just as unacceptable as Maiara's… and Yacamim's." They stare each other down, until Neferteri closes her eyes. "Princess Nina, please come in."
35cdee85b8e7.t: “Beta Permaisuri Sanbi, tetapi lebih daripada itu, beta ibu kepada empat orang puteri. Beta mempercayakan anakanda tugas penting walaupun beta ragu dengan kebolehan anakanda menjaga orang lain. Tetapi ketidakupayaan anakanda mengawal emosi ternyata sama tidak boleh diterimanya seperti Maiara… dan Yacamim.” Mereka saling merenung, sehingga Neferteri memejamkan mata. “Puteri Nina, sila masuk.”

3710de2bbc7e.en: Aurora slowly backs away. "OH NO! You come back here!" "I'm sorry, Princess, but I'm not sure what to say about this." "What? It's dead simple! I asked for Harry! He's mine!" "Asked?" Eori: "No! He's mine! You won the battle, which means you lost Harry!" "But that doesn't mean he's yours!"
3710de2bbc7e.t: Aurora perlahan-lahan berundur. “OH TAK! Kau datang balik sini!” “Maaf, Tuan Puteri, tapi saya tak pasti nak cakap apa tentang hal ini.” “Apa? Senang saja! Aku yang minta Harry! Dia milik aku!” “Minta?” Eori: “Tak! Dia milik aku! Kau menang pertarungan, maknanya kau kehilangan Harry!” “Tapi tak bermakna dia milik kau!”

39fb564ac7c0.en: Neferteri tells Nina that Eori has been behaving badly, and she needs all the support she can get. Nina says she'll help, then asks why they're hiding behind nari gel.
39fb564ac7c0.t: Neferteri memberitahu Nina bahawa Eori berkelakuan buruk, dan dia perlukan semua sokongan yang boleh didapatinya. Nina kata dia akan membantu, kemudian bertanya kenapa mereka bersembunyi di sebalik nari gel.

3b9be63a2329.en: Harry and the Bagarisas settle in to sleep, full
3b9be63a2329.t: Harry dan Bagarisa bersiap untuk tidur, kenyang

418857ecb413.en: Neferteri and Nina, back at Sanbi Castle
418857ecb413.t: Neferteri dan Nina, kembali di Sanbi Castle

43195101199d.en: Hiromi laughs it off. "My bad, I guess. I just remember her being innocent. I haven't really talked to her in years." "If you laid off the booze every time we went to the castle, you'd probably remember something, you fat cunt." "You're drinking too, cut the crap." "Fuck you! You're the one emptying our home stockpile!" "Fuck that! Fuck you!" He stands and pumps his arm, calling her out for a throwdown.
43195101199d.t: Hiromi ketawa saja. “Salah aku, kot. Aku cuma ingat dia dulu naif. Dah bertahun aku tak betul-betul bercakap dengan dia.” “Kalau kau kurangkan arak setiap kali kita pergi istana, mungkin kau ingat sesuatu, kau pantat gemuk.” “Kau pun minum, jangan merepek.” “Kena main kau! Kau yang habiskan stok rumah kita!” “Celaka! Kena main kau!” Dia berdiri dan mengepam lengan, mencabarnya bertumbuk.

435e94827567.en: A Bagarisa heals Harry, and he cuddles it. "Thank you! I love you guys!" Happy oinks. Then he gets sad again: he's still stuck in the forest.
435e94827567.t: Seekor Bagarisa menyembuhkan Harry, dan dia memeluknya. “Terima kasih! Aku sayang korang!” Dengusan gembira. Kemudian dia sedih lagi: dia masih tersangkut di hutan.

449c3ce8c116.en: If enough people ever harass Deo into finishing the story, these notes are the base, changed only as much as needed to keep everything lore-accurate. Most of this was written before Arc 1's notes were fully expanded into the published books, so Vols 1 to 4 are the lore-accurate version wherever they conflict. There's a lot to keep track of, almost as if someone decided to challenge themselves a bit too much, for fun…
449c3ce8c116.t: Kalau cukup ramai orang mendesak Deo menghabiskan cerita ini, nota-nota inilah asasnya, diubah hanya sebanyak yang perlu supaya semuanya tepat dengan lore. Kebanyakannya ditulis sebelum nota Arka 1 dikembangkan sepenuhnya menjadi buku yang diterbitkan, jadi Jilid 1 hingga 4 ialah versi yang tepat dengan lore di mana-mana yang bercanggah. Banyak benda yang perlu dijejaki, seolah-olah ada orang yang memutuskan untuk mencabar diri sendiri lebih sedikit daripada sepatutnya, saja suka-suka…

471d6b5f96bb.en: The others, a female among them, cast a spell at the foliage to curse the fruit down. One crashes onto Harry's hand and lands by his groin. Remembering the last fruit, he watches the Bagarisas eat first, only the white inside, then follows suit, and almost cums from how good it is. Together, they strip the tree bare.
471d6b5f96bb.t: Yang lain, seekor betina antaranya, melempar jampi ke arah dedaun untuk menyumpah buah-buah itu jatuh. Sebiji terhempas ke tangan Harry dan jatuh di celah kelangkangnya. Teringat buah yang lepas, dia memerhati Bagarisa makan dulu, hanya isi putihnya, kemudian ikut sama, dan hampir terpancut kerana betapa sedapnya. Bersama-sama, mereka melondehkan pokok itu sampai licin.

48ac0bf31fc3.en: Eiri goes on the defensive. "But this is for the better! We lost Arukia!" Silence; Sora peeks out of the pillow with teary eyes, then hides again. "I thought you always told me everything! Sora! I don't want to hurt you! Or you two! Why didn't anybody say anything?" Itanema: "Because you only ever believe Sora anyway."
48ac0bf31fc3.t: Eiri menjadi defensif. “Tapi ini untuk kebaikan! Kita dah kehilangan Arukia!” Senyap; Sora mengintai dari bantal dengan mata berair, kemudian bersembunyi lagi. “Aku ingat kau selalu beritahu aku semuanya! Sora! Aku tak nak sakiti kau! Atau korang berdua! Kenapa tak ada siapa cakap apa-apa?” Itanema: “Sebab kau cuma percaya Sora saja pun.”

48b958ea76a3.en: The sisters and the Black Magina man
48b958ea76a3.t: Adik-beradik itu dan lelaki Black Magina

507d2d052d81.en: One of them steps forward. "We want you to retire." "Sure. How do I do that?"
507d2d052d81.t: Seorang daripada mereka melangkah ke depan. “Kami nak tuan bersara.” “Boleh. Macam mana nak buat?”

518ccb06c927.en: "Princesses! Please!" Both stare at Aurora so hard she feels she might crumble. "Princess Maiara, how did you ask for Harry?" The princesses glance at each other, as if suddenly realizing something. Eori crosses her arms. "Maiara asked for a husband who could match her in combat, and Gabiro found someone from the outskirts who apparently had great innate power."
518ccb06c927.t: “Tuan-tuan Puteri! Tolonglah!” Kedua-duanya merenung Aurora begitu tajam hingga dia rasa seperti akan runtuh. “Puteri Maiara, macam mana tuan puteri minta Harry?” Kedua puteri itu saling mengerling, seolah-olah tiba-tiba menyedari sesuatu. Eori memeluk tubuh. “Maiara minta suami yang boleh menandinginya dalam pertempuran, dan Gabiro jumpa seseorang dari pinggir kota yang nampaknya ada kuasa semula jadi yang hebat.”

52239424c0bb.en: Hand on his stomach, he finds a fruit that looks too delicious to be true, and eats his fill. He feels amazing, like never before.
52239424c0bb.t: Tangan di perut, dia menjumpai sebiji buah yang nampak terlalu sedap untuk jadi kenyataan, dan makan sepuas-puasnya. Dia rasa luar biasa, tidak pernah serasa begini.

53a38a94d011.en: "What are you talking about? I am your sister! Listen here! I just want us to be free! Emelia, Arukia and all the other Red Winga people are full of shit!" Katsuki hangs her head and goes silent. "There's no going back now. C'mon. Let's go."
53a38a94d011.t: “Apa kau merepek ni? Akulah kakak kau! Dengar sini! Aku cuma nak kita bebas! Emelia, Arukia dan semua orang Red Winga yang lain tu penuh tahi!” Katsuki menunduk dan diam. “Tak boleh patah balik sekarang. Jom. Kita pergi.”

54a65770af7c.en: Huneo shakes his head. "You're missing a few steps. First, the three others need to approve a new apprentice. Second, a public hair paint must happen. Third, you need to train me up to par. Fourth, you resign publicly, and I take over the post at a public event, too. Those last two can be the same event."
54a65770af7c.t: Huneo menggeleng. “Tuan tertinggal beberapa langkah. Pertama, tiga yang lain perlu meluluskan perantis baharu. Kedua, upacara cat rambut awam mesti diadakan. Ketiga, tuan perlu melatih saya sampai setaraf. Keempat, tuan meletak jawatan secara terbuka, dan saya mengambil alih jawatan itu di acara awam juga. Dua yang terakhir boleh jadi acara yang sama.”

550ef8a8295f.en: Chapter 4 - Something fishy, and it ain’t the docks
550ef8a8295f.t: Bab 4 - Ada yang berbau ikan, dan bukan dermaga

56e40339dc86.en: The sisters forced to work a Magina field
56e40339dc86.t: Adik-beradik itu dipaksa bekerja di ladang Magina

580e794bec15.en: She seems to get away with it, and she learns a whole lot from trying. "Boss doesn't need to know about the fun times we're having."
580e794bec15.t: Dia nampaknya terlepas, dan dia belajar banyak daripada percubaan itu. “Bos tak perlu tahu pasal seronok-seronok kita ni.”

597ebf355ee5.en: Katsumi refuses to spill the beans and spits in the man's face; he slaps her back. Katsuki looks away from her sister, and spills them.
597ebf355ee5.t: Katsumi enggan membocorkan rahsia dan meludah muka lelaki itu; dia menampar balik. Katsuki memalingkan muka daripada kakaknya, dan membocorkannya.

5ba435cdc97e.en: In a flash, the Bagarisas and Wozens are at each other. Harry watches the Bagarisa that healed him agonize over its death, just like he did, and anger and hatred brew inside him.
5ba435cdc97e.t: Sekelip mata, Bagarisa dan Wozen bertempur sesama sendiri. Harry melihat Bagarisa yang menyembuhkannya menderita menghadapi kematiannya, sama seperti dirinya dahulu, dan kemarahan dan kebencian menggelegak dalam dirinya.

5c48f2276df6.en: The beast jumps back, then claws open his gut. His intestines spill out onto his skin; the throbbing pain fades, and his whole body warms up. With his last strength, Harry puts his hand on the beast and screams, or rather gurgles, as the flame takes over his fingers and flashes up his forearm before going out.
5c48f2276df6.t: Makhluk itu melompat ke belakang, kemudian mencakar perutnya hingga terbuka. Ususnya terburai ke atas kulitnya; sakit yang berdenyut pudar, dan seluruh badannya menjadi hangat. Dengan sisa tenaganya, Harry meletakkan tangan pada makhluk itu dan menjerit, atau lebih tepat berdeguk, ketika api menguasai jarinya dan menyambar naik ke lengan bawahnya sebelum padam.

5ed877875744.en: They're swapping stories about their adventures and exploits when a tipsy female adventurer plops down next to Hiromi. "Hey! You two! Wanna buy me a beer in exchange for some awesome gossip?"
5ed877875744.t: Mereka sedang bertukar cerita tentang pengembaraan dan aksi mereka apabila seorang pengembara wanita yang separuh mabuk menghenyakkan diri di sebelah Hiromi. “Hoi! Korang berdua! Nak belanja aku bir sebagai tukaran gosip power?”

5f504e25804b.en: Neferteri says it's super secret research that other kingdoms would try to steal, so it has to stay super secret, even from Father. Nina giggles: "Okay!"
5f504e25804b.t: Neferteri kata ia penyelidikan yang sangat rahsia yang kerajaan lain akan cuba curi, jadi ia mesti kekal sangat rahsia, malah daripada Ayahanda. Nina ketawa kecil: “Okey!”

5f5c4180b753.en: Arukia's face flashes in Eori's mind, and she feels the urge to explode and smash Eiri's face. She turns back to the window. "Get out." "You know, if you need—" "GET OUT—NOW!" A pillow flies; Eiri steps back, hangs her head and leaves.
5f5c4180b753.t: Wajah Arukia terimbas dalam fikiran Eori, dan dia rasa terdesak untuk meletup dan menghancurkan muka Eiri. Dia berpaling semula ke tingkap. “Keluar.” “Kau tahu, kalau kau perlukan—” “KELUAR—SEKARANG!” Sebiji bantal melayang; Eiri berundur, menunduk dan beredar.

61311b1257e3.en: Through the metal-framed window, Katsuki sees her sister run, then suddenly fall, while the Black Magina field boss has his way with her. She closes her eyes against his boozy breath and tries to ignore it, imagining what life would have been like if the Red Winga had never captured them. Blank. She tries harder, but nothing comes, until she feels him finish inside her. She feels it all, but chooses not to. Memories of her life drift in and out, and it has been nothing but pleasing others.
61311b1257e3.t: Melalui tingkap berbingkai logam, Katsuki melihat kakaknya berlari, kemudian tiba-tiba jatuh, sementara bos ladang Black Magina melampiaskan nafsunya kepadanya. Dia memejamkan mata menahan nafasnya yang berbau arak dan cuba mengabaikannya, membayangkan bagaimana hidup jika Red Winga tidak pernah menangkap mereka. Kosong. Dia cuba lebih kuat, tetapi tiada apa yang datang, sehingga dia rasa lelaki itu terpancut di dalamnya. Dia merasai semuanya, tetapi memilih untuk tidak. Ingatan hidupnya datang dan pergi, dan ia tiada lain hanyalah memuaskan orang lain.

613cd16213cc.en: Yacamim: "How about my foot up your ass? Huh?" Hiromi hugs the adventurer and clinks beers. "Shhhhh, lady! Let her peddle her stuff. All right, what kind of gossip are we talking about?" Like a certain missing person a certain someone is offering ten Sapphires for.
613cd16213cc.t: Yacamim: “Macam mana kalau kaki aku masuk lubang bontot kau? Hah?” Hiromi memeluk pengembara itu dan melagakan bir. “Shhhhh, cik! Biar dia jual barang dia. Okey, gosip jenis apa ni?” Macam seorang yang hilang yang seseorang tawarkan sepuluh Sapphire untuknya.

627989dd34e2.en: She clears her throat. "The law was followed to the letter, albeit hastily. My vote has no bearing on the matter. Shall we continue?"
627989dd34e2.t: Dia berdehem. “Undang-undang telah dipatuhi sepenuhnya, walaupun tergesa-gesa. Undi beta tidak memberi kesan kepada perkara ini. Boleh kita teruskan?”

630a219bab07.en: Hiromi twirls a finger at the bartender, who gives a thumbs-up. "Lemme guess: the Blue Wozens kidnapped a rich merchant's kid again?" "Not even close, you giant feller! The Sanbi Royals posted a quest a few days ago, calling every adventurer to find a guy called Harry. I think Eori's in heat over him or something, too."
630a219bab07.t: Hiromi memusingkan jari kepada pelayan bar, yang mengangkat ibu jari. “Biar aku teka: Blue Wozens culik anak saudagar kaya lagi?” “Jauh panggang dari api, kau budak gergasi! Sanbi Royals letak misi beberapa hari lepas, panggil setiap pengembara untuk cari seorang lelaki nama Harry. Aku rasa Eori pun tengah gersang sebab dia ke apa.”

65e4696df041.en: He steps out early in the morning, the Bagarisas around him, and laziness sets in: as crude as it is, this place is growing on him like a home. "Let's explore up north today."
65e4696df041.t: Dia melangkah keluar awal pagi, Bagarisa di sekelilingnya, dan rasa malas datang: walaupun kasar, tempat ini semakin terasa seperti rumah baginya. “Jom kita teroka ke utara hari ni.”

65fe4e53960d.en: "All right then, you're now my apprentice." Kibe glances at the clouds, then back at the young man. "Now you're the courtroom scientist."
65fe4e53960d.t: “Baiklah kalau macam tu, kau sekarang perantis aku.” Kibe mengerling awan, kemudian kembali kepada pemuda itu. “Sekarang kau saintis istana.”

6801c0f90bda.en: Neferteri sits across from Eori, adventurers standing by her, an empty seat at her side. Eori stares at her with some of Yacamim and Maiara's look. "So what now?"
6801c0f90bda.t: Neferteri duduk bertentangan Eori, pengembara berdiri di sisinya, sebuah kerusi kosong di sebelahnya. Eori merenungnya dengan sedikit pandangan Yacamim dan Maiara. “Jadi sekarang apa?”

6a32c22f21e0.en: Maiara throws down hers and stands. "Are you calling me lazy? Say that to my face again, if you fucking dare!" Eori stands too, finally saying what she has wanted to for years: "You're a lazy bitch!" Maiara grabs her by the collar; Eori grabs her by the hair.
6a32c22f21e0.t: Maiara mencampak miliknya dan berdiri. “Kau panggil aku malas? Cakap depan muka aku sekali lagi, kalau kau berani, celaka!” Eori berdiri juga, akhirnya mengatakan apa yang ingin dikatakannya bertahun-tahun: “Kau jalang pemalas!” Maiara mencekak kolarnya; Eori menarik rambutnya.

6d1070731ea9.en: Neferteri is trying to break her own patterns by getting even more involved with Nina. She knows her narcissistic tendencies, and realizes she's repeating the same controlling bullshit her own parents did, but her conviction that she can do things differently speaks louder: that somehow she can steer the ship back from how far it has drifted from the reality she designed.
6d1070731ea9.t: Neferteri cuba memecahkan corak dirinya sendiri dengan melibatkan diri lebih lagi dengan Nina. Dia tahu kecenderungan narsisistiknya, dan sedar dia mengulangi karut mengawal yang sama yang dibuat ibu bapanya sendiri, tetapi keyakinannya bahawa dia boleh melakukannya secara berbeza bersuara lebih kuat: bahawa entah bagaimana dia boleh mengemudi kapal itu kembali dari sejauh mana ia telah hanyut daripada realiti yang dia reka.

6d32875c51a0.en: "Damn, brotha! Haven't seen you since you retired!" "Still living the life? I'm done with adventuring. Found what I wanted." "For fucking real? You actually found the juiciest pussy in the four kingdoms? Damn, brotha. Proud of ya!" They clasp hands and trade more stories, while a sexually deflated Yacamim rolls her eyes, tosses a few Amethysts on the table and leaves.
6d32875c51a0.t: “Celaka, brotha! Tak nampak kau sejak kau bersara!” “Masih hidup macam dulu? Aku dah habis mengembara. Dah jumpa apa yang aku cari.” “Betul-betul ke ni? Kau betul-betul jumpa pantat paling berair dalam empat kerajaan? Celaka, brotha. Bangga dengan kau!” Mereka berjabat tangan dan bertukar lebih banyak cerita, sementara Yacamim yang nafsunya mati menjeling, mencampak beberapa Amethyst ke atas meja dan beredar.

71ace8ef7df1.en: "Can you guys help me out of here?" Oinks. Wait. Where would I even go? More oinks: they point in a direction, and Harry follows.
71ace8ef7df1.t: “Boleh tak korang tolong aku keluar dari sini?” Dengusan. Kejap. Aku nak pergi mana sebenarnya? Lebih banyak dengusan: mereka menunjuk ke satu arah, dan Harry mengikut.

72011f6d5c5d.en: "So who did he sign a contract with?" In unison: "The Queen." "Can't you ask her to decide, then?" They avoid each other's eyes, and Maiara leaves without a word. Aurora smiles. A princess lovers' quarrel over a slum boy? I need to tell the girls right now!
72011f6d5c5d.t: “Jadi dengan siapa dia tandatangan kontrak?” Serentak: “Permaisuri.” “Tak boleh ke minta baginda putuskan, kalau begitu?” Mereka mengelak pandangan antara satu sama lain, dan Maiara beredar tanpa sepatah kata. Aurora tersenyum. Puteri-puteri bergaduh cinta pasal budak setinggan? Aku kena beritahu geng aku sekarang juga!

72c1405da7ed.en: "Are we in the clear?" Namia: "I don't hear anyone. Go ahead, my queen."
72c1405da7ed.t: “Kita selamat?” Namia: “Aku tak dengar sesiapa. Silakan, permaisuriku.”

7373f3c25c07.en: Katsumi picks Magina and slams it into the bag, one after another. Someone behind her slaps her for not taking care of the product. She shoves the bag at him, catches him by surprise, throws dirt on him, pushes him aside and runs.
7373f3c25c07.t: Katsumi memetik Magina dan menghempasnya ke dalam beg, satu demi satu. Seseorang di belakangnya menamparnya kerana tidak menjaga hasil. Dia menolak beg itu kepadanya, mengejutkannya, membaling tanah kepadanya, menolaknya ke tepi dan berlari.

76ba646bc6be.en: "I like her. Send her to my quarters." Katsumi spits on Katsuki. "We're done."
76ba646bc6be.t: “Aku suka dia. Hantar dia ke bilik aku.” Katsumi meludah Katsuki. “Kita dah putus.”

78ccf82c7278.en: She imagines all the fun she had with Harry, and craves his smell, his touch and his obedience. She wants to go back to the house, but she can't, now that Neferteri has terminated her contract.
78ccf82c7278.t: Dia membayangkan semua keseronokan yang dia ada dengan Harry, dan mengidamkan baunya, sentuhannya dan kepatuhannya. Dia mahu kembali ke rumah itu, tetapi dia tidak boleh, sekarang setelah Neferteri menamatkan kontraknya.

7c3f18820260.en: Autumn colors, the leaves starting to fall. Harry runs, and runs, and runs some more; he doesn't even remember for how long. His legs grow heavy, then his whole body, until he loses his balance, crashes into a tree and falls.
7c3f18820260.t: Warna musim luruh, daun mula gugur. Harry berlari, dan berlari, dan berlari lagi; dia tidak ingat pun berapa lama. Kakinya semakin berat, kemudian seluruh badannya, sehingga dia hilang imbangan, merempuh sebatang pokok dan jatuh.

82e7154c57b6.t: Harry #8-B melawan haiwan liar bersama Bagarisa

82ed6b5ba171.en: Eori, alone in her tower, watches Sanbi bustle below
82ed6b5ba171.t: Eori, seorang diri di menaranya, memerhati Sanbi yang sibuk di bawah

83e1182d27c2.en: Harry spots a village in the distance
83e1182d27c2.t: Harry ternampak sebuah kampung di kejauhan

83e5afffd973.en: Chapter 3 - Payback's a bitch and a half.
83e5afffd973.t: Bab 3 - Balasan memang celaka setengah mati.

84dfe5c02e89.en: Spoiler warning: these are unreleased story notes.
84dfe5c02e89.t: Amaran bocoran: ini nota cerita yang belum diterbitkan.

8712079cd619.en: The forest at the field's edge invites her to freedom, until an arrow pierces her knee and brings her down. Screaming in agony, her knee torn up and bleeding, she crawls toward the edge until her body gives out.
8712079cd619.t: Hutan di pinggir ladang menjemputnya kepada kebebasan, sehingga sebatang anak panah menembusi lututnya dan menjatuhkannya. Menjerit kesakitan, lututnya hancur dan berdarah, dia merangkak ke arah pinggir hingga badannya menyerah.

87801583e4b4.en: Katsuki throws weak punches; Katsumi takes them like nothing. "Don't you realize we had to leave him behind? He became luggage the moment he hit the ground hard!"
87801583e4b4.t: Katsuki melepaskan tumbukan lemah; Katsumi menerimanya seperti tiada apa-apa. “Kau tak sedar ke kita terpaksa tinggalkan dia? Dia jadi beban sebaik saja dia jatuh terhempas!”

87ea91b57f4c.en: Eori cries tears of pure anger, pounding the bed with all her might. Over and over, she sees her tormentor's face, and imagines how tender and sweet it would be to take its life.
87ea91b57f4c.t: Eori menangis air mata kemarahan tulen, menumbuk katil sekuat hati. Berulang-ulang, dia nampak wajah penyeksanya, dan membayangkan betapa lembut dan manisnya untuk meragut nyawanya.

88460b4ff102.en: Eiri bursts out laughing, looking up at the castle towers. "Did Eori just say she loves Harry?" Sora: "That was her, without a doubt." "Hmmm. Good that she broke out of her shell, I guess, but where did that come from?" "Love at first sight?" Eiri suspects something fishy. "I guess that's a thing. Maybe all those girly novels rotted her brain." Sora's puffed cheeks give her away. "Okay! I know you like them too, but you're not screaming someone's name out the window!—yet!"
88460b4ff102.t: Eiri ketawa terbahak-bahak, mendongak ke menara istana. “Eori baru cakap dia cintakan Harry ke?” Sora: “Itu dia, tak syak lagi.” “Hmmm. Baguslah dia keluar dari cengkerang dia, kot, tapi dari mana datangnya tu?” “Cinta pandang pertama?” Eiri mengesyaki ada yang tak kena. “Rasanya benda tu wujud. Mungkin semua novel perempuan tu dah busukkan otak dia.” Pipi Sora yang mengembung membongkarnya. “Okey! Aku tahu kau pun suka novel tu, tapi kau tak menjerit nama orang keluar tingkap!—belum lagi!”

8f0326989ba4.en: Katsumi holds her hands. "All right, cut it out! Harry is not a savior. He's a nobody like us, and what do nobodies do? They save themselves!"
8f0326989ba4.t: Katsumi memegang tangannya. “Sudah, hentikan! Harry bukan penyelamat. Dia orang biasa macam kita, dan apa orang biasa buat? Mereka selamatkan diri sendiri!”

91bd37922549.en: His arm slumps to the ground, and so does his head. Harry Sanbi dies in the middle of butt-fuck nowhere.
91bd37922549.t: Lengannya terkulai ke tanah, begitu juga kepalanya. Harry Sanbi mati di tengah-tengah ceruk hutan entah ke mana celaka.

93cd596ed9f9.en: From far off, he hears children playing and people going about their lives. He stands still: he wants to go, and at the same time he doesn't. What if Eori finds me? What if the Red Winga find me? He slips back into the forest.
93cd596ed9f9.t: Dari jauh, dia mendengar kanak-kanak bermain dan orang menjalani hidup. Dia berdiri kaku: dia mahu pergi, dan pada masa yang sama dia tidak mahu. Macam mana kalau Eori jumpa aku? Macam mana kalau Red Winga jumpa aku? Dia menyelinap kembali ke dalam hutan.

93e2586342c2.en: Something moves on his left. "AGRHGHRHHRHGR!" A toothy mouth flashes in front of him and takes him to the ground, and he feels warmth again: his own blood, squirting from his neck. I don't wanna die! I don't wanna die! He flails and hits the beast right in the eyes.
93e2586342c2.t: Sesuatu bergerak di sebelah kirinya. “AGRHGHRHHRHGR!” Mulut penuh gigi berkelip di depannya dan menjatuhkannya ke tanah, dan dia rasa hangat semula: darahnya sendiri, memancut dari lehernya. Aku tak nak mati! Aku tak nak mati! Dia meronta-ronta dan memukul makhluk itu tepat di matanya.

97d9c1da624c.en: Huneo: "Arranging the ceremony. I'd like it done in two days." Itagiba: "That soon? There won't be enough time to advertise it." Neferteri stays silent, still suspicious. Huneo points at his massive list of reforms. "There's no time to be jerking around."
97d9c1da624c.t: Huneo: “Mengatur upacara. Saya mahu ia diadakan dalam dua hari.” Itagiba: “Secepat itu? Tak cukup masa untuk mengiklankannya.” Neferteri terus diam, masih curiga. Huneo menunjuk senarai pembaharuannya yang panjang berjela. “Tiada masa untuk main-main.”

9a62451017d6.en: Hiromi and Yacamim at a small roadside bar between Forway and Sanbi
9a62451017d6.t: Hiromi dan Yacamim di sebuah bar kecil tepi jalan antara Forway dan Sanbi

9d717c6e176c.en: The room goes silent, then fills with murmurs about what needs to happen. One confident voice in the back cuts through with a sharp clearing of the throat: "According to Sanbi law, only an apprentice can replace a courtroom scientist." It's Huneo.
9d717c6e176c.t: Bilik itu sunyi, kemudian dipenuhi bisikan tentang apa yang perlu dilakukan. Satu suara yakin di belakang memotong dengan berdehem tajam: “Menurut undang-undang Sanbi, hanya perantis boleh menggantikan saintis istana.” Itu Huneo.

9df679131884.en: He's against the same tree, his shirt in tatters. Everything is back where it belongs, but he's even thinner now, and so are two of the Bagarisas. They healed me! He hugs the two underweight ones. "I'm sorry! I'm sorry! I didn't know!" Understanding oinks, if such a thing can be inferred.
9df679131884.t: Dia bersandar pada pokok yang sama, bajunya compang-camping. Semuanya kembali di tempat asal, tetapi dia lebih kurus sekarang, begitu juga dua ekor Bagarisa. Mereka sembuhkan aku! Dia memeluk dua ekor yang kurus itu. “Maaf! Maaf! Aku tak tahu!” Dengusan memahami, kalau benda macam tu boleh disimpulkan.

9f34e9cf1a95.en: Maiara blushes and glances at Eori. "I'm not lazy!" Aurora: "And everyone knows your accomplishments too, Princess Eori. I can tell you're just burned out from your research. Give it some time, maybe travel a bit to get your mojo back!" She puts her hands on Maiara's broad shoulders. "Maybe cheer on Princess Maiara's tournament?" Maiara keeps glancing at Eori with an attention-seeking smile, and Eori smiles a little.
9f34e9cf1a95.t: Maiara tersipu dan mengerling Eori. “Aku tak malas!” Aurora: “Dan semua orang tahu pencapaian tuan puteri juga, Puteri Eori. Saya boleh nampak tuan puteri cuma keletihan dengan penyelidikan. Beri masa, mungkin mengembara sikit untuk dapatkan semangat balik!” Dia meletakkan tangan di bahu Maiara yang lebar. “Mungkin bersorak untuk kejohanan Puteri Maiara?” Maiara terus mengerling Eori dengan senyuman meminta perhatian, dan Eori tersenyum sedikit.

9fc7d713ad1b.en: Harry lights the fost stone, and the Bagarisas all flee outside, spooked; he tries to play with them, but they won't come back.
9fc7d713ad1b.t: Harry menyalakan fost stone, dan semua Bagarisa lari keluar, terkejut; dia cuba bermain dengan mereka, tetapi mereka tidak mahu kembali.

9fcc73db3d40.en: They still stink, but not so bad anymore; maybe his nose stopped working, but who cares. He feels amazing comfort and protection: the cold wind now feels like an A/C breeze keeping a cozy blanket just right.
9fcc73db3d40.t: Mereka masih busuk, tetapi tidak seteruk tadi; mungkin hidungnya dah tak berfungsi, tapi siapa peduli. Dia rasa selesa dan terlindung luar biasa: angin sejuk kini terasa seperti angin penghawa dingin yang mengekalkan selimut yang nyaman pada tahap yang betul.

a09c4cdba0dd.en: "Let's do that, then. Let's go get the approval. Everyone else, just go already." "Not so easy. You need to write a letter summarizing all my qualities, and why I'm the one." Kibe groans. "How do I write this letter?" "I can show you."
a09c4cdba0dd.t: “Jom buat macam tu. Jom pergi dapatkan kelulusan. Yang lain, pergi sajalah.” “Tak semudah itu. Tuan perlu tulis surat yang merumuskan semua kelebihan saya, dan kenapa saya orangnya.” Kibe mengerang. “Macam mana nak tulis surat ni?” “Saya boleh tunjukkan.”

a386ab5c6fad.en: Katsumi looks for a way out

a7943c4dae2f.en: Kibe and Huneo meet with Neferteri, Itagiba and Eiri
a7943c4dae2f.t: Kibe dan Huneo bertemu Neferteri, Itagiba dan Eiri

a7fc6561e1a7.en: Nina reads the contract to Eori, with Neferteri's help
a7fc6561e1a7.t: Nina membacakan kontrak kepada Eori, dengan bantuan Neferteri

ad8e8f4b6508.en: Eiri's eyes well up. "Everyone's hiding secrets from me! This isn't fair! FINE! Do what you want! I'm going back to the castle." As she leaves, the pillow flies, and Sora hugs her from behind. "I'm sorry!"
ad8e8f4b6508.t: Mata Eiri bergenang. “Semua orang berahsia dengan aku! Tak adil! OKEY! Buat apa korang nak! Aku balik istana.” Ketika dia beredar, bantal melayang, dan Sora memeluknya dari belakang. “Maafkan aku!”

ae6603b7662c.en: Maiara wins the final round. Eori throws down her pieces, downs her drink and slams the cup. "How can you live like this? This is too boring!"
ae6603b7662c.t: Maiara memenangi pusingan akhir. Eori mencampak buah permainannya, meneguk minumannya dan menghempas cawan. “Macam mana kau boleh hidup macam ni? Bosan gila!”

b1657bc6488b.en: He pulls out, slaps her ass and walks out. Katsuki just stands there, waiting for something. Anything.
b1657bc6488b.t: Lelaki itu menarik keluar, menampar punggungnya dan keluar. Katsuki hanya berdiri di situ, menunggu sesuatu. Apa saja.

b38275b7de2d.en: Yacamim sits back down and slams her mug so hard it dings both the mug and the table. "Hey, you two! Gonna pay for that, or do you want someone to teach you a lesson?" A big man, not unlike Hiromi but much older, comes out of the corner. They square up, fists thirsting for blood, and at the last second do the Darfaries greeting.
b38275b7de2d.t: Yacamim duduk semula dan menghempas kolenya begitu kuat hingga kole dan meja itu kemik. “Hoi, korang berdua! Nak bayar ke, atau nak orang ajar korang?” Seorang lelaki besar, tidak jauh beza dengan Hiromi tetapi jauh lebih tua, keluar dari sudut. Mereka bersemuka, penumbuk dahagakan darah, dan pada saat akhir melakukan salam Darfaries.

ba8d2785ef50.en: He injures one, but the other kills him. This happens before the prologue of Book 1 (see the Webcomic).
ba8d2785ef50.t: Dia mencederakan seorang, tetapi yang seorang lagi membunuhnya. Ini berlaku sebelum prolog Buku 1 (lihat Webcomic).

bcf4232871f7.en: The sisters flee the bandits in the rain
bcf4232871f7.t: Adik-beradik itu lari daripada penyamun dalam hujan

bd8c6ea3bf01.en: Eori and Maiara, drinks in hand, play Minari in the castle parlor
bd8c6ea3bf01.t: Eori dan Maiara, minuman di tangan, bermain Minari di ruang tamu istana

c02578ef85a4.en: The cold rain feels like ice cubes trying to pierce his skin. The fire on his fingertips is his only salvation, until a gust of wind breaks his concentration and puts it out. He's shaking too much to light it again; the bitter cold takes over his mind every time. Wozen eyes watch from the background.
c02578ef85a4.t: Hujan sejuk terasa seperti ketulan ais cuba menembusi kulitnya. Api di hujung jarinya satu-satunya penyelamat, sehingga sehembus angin memecahkan tumpuannya dan memadamkannya. Dia menggigil terlalu kuat untuk menyalakannya lagi; sejuk yang pedih menguasai mindanya setiap kali. Mata Wozen memerhati dari belakang.

c4e2bdaf4f31.en: Harry wakes up sweating, Bagarisas sleeping all over him
c4e2bdaf4f31.t: Harry bangun berpeluh, Bagarisa tidur bertindih di atasnya

c8a8fb369ae0.en: The maids in Sora's dormitory room, all clean and girly
c8a8fb369ae0.t: Para pembantu rumah dalam bilik asrama Sora, semuanya bersih dan feminin

cb2272b124c8.en: The sisters walk the road at sunrise, Katsumi pulling Katsuki along
cb2272b124c8.t: Adik-beradik itu berjalan di jalan ketika matahari terbit, Katsumi menarik Katsuki bersama

cb625f670f55.en: Sticks and stones are encrusted in his soles like jewels, painful, macabre ones. Pulling one out feels like a needle through the bone, followed by a warm, pounding tickle as his accelerated healing kicks in: he laughs, cries and agonizes all at once. He cleans his feet one stone at a time, but the healing gets slower with each one.
cb625f670f55.t: Ranting dan batu terbenam di tapak kakinya seperti permata, permata yang menyakitkan dan mengerikan. Mencabut satu terasa seperti jarum menembusi tulang, diikuti geli hangat yang berdenyut apabila penyembuhan pantasnya bermula: dia ketawa, menangis dan menderita serentak. Dia membersihkan kakinya satu batu demi satu batu, tetapi penyembuhannya semakin perlahan dengan setiap satu.

cce95e23cf1e.en: Three full beers slap onto the table. Yacamim looks doubtful, but drowns it in a large beer. Hiromi: "When did your sister get that frisky?" Yacamim spit-takes all over the table and chokes, turning heads in the bar. "You fucking cunt. Why would you put it like that?"
cce95e23cf1e.t: Tiga kole bir penuh dihempas ke atas meja. Yacamim nampak ragu, tetapi menenggelamkannya dalam sekole besar bir. Hiromi: “Bila adik kau jadi gatal macam tu?” Yacamim tersembur bir ke seluruh meja dan tercekik, membuat orang di bar menoleh. “Kau pantat celaka. Kenapa kau cakap macam tu?”

cecc565a8774.en: "Harry? I love him. I want him!" "The search quest has been created." "Thank you, Mom. What will happen to the contracts I signed?" "I'll deal with them. Nina, shall we all put our disguises on and go back to the castle?" "Yeahhh!" A crying Nina joins in a group hug.
cecc565a8774.t: “Harry? Aku cintakan dia. Aku nak dia!” “Misi pencarian sudah dibuat.” “Terima kasih, Mak. Apa jadi dengan kontrak-kontrak yang aku tandatangan?” “Bonda akan uruskan. Nina, jom kita semua pakai penyamaran dan balik ke istana?” “Yeayyy!” Nina yang menangis menyertai pelukan berkumpulan.

d0d4d064686d.en: A dream: a Bagarisa man fights two adventurers
d0d4d064686d.t: Mimpi: seorang lelaki Bagarisa melawan dua orang pengembara

d0e0e0663a9b.en: Namia apologizes: she was so sure of her findings when she first observed Arukia. Neferteri: "I don't doubt your expertise, Namia. Arukia was simply too clever at disguising who she truly was."
d0e0e0663a9b.t: Namia meminta maaf: dia begitu yakin dengan penemuannya ketika mula-mula memerhati Arukia. Neferteri: “Beta tidak meragui kepakaranmu, Namia. Arukia cuma terlalu bijak menyamarkan siapa dirinya yang sebenar.”

d3b6ea1cf087.en: The books and things inside are deteriorated. The only map he finds doesn't show where he is. He sighs, spots a fishing rod, and goes to sleep.
d3b6ea1cf087.t: Buku-buku dan barang di dalamnya sudah rosak. Satu-satunya peta yang dijumpainya tidak menunjukkan di mana dia berada. Dia mengeluh, ternampak joran pancing, dan pergi tidur.

d61215b2f387.en: Kibe: "That's it. You can all go now." The captains stand up, refusing to leave. "What? We're done with the city safety debriefing."
d61215b2f387.t: Kibe: “Itu saja. Korang semua boleh pergi.” Para kapten berdiri, enggan beredar. “Apa? Kita dah habis taklimat keselamatan bandar.”

d64c389f9ac9.en: Neferteri is playing a bit coy (cu doce, as they say in Portuguese): she senses Huneo isn't someone she can easily control. She changes her mind in Book 7, once she learns how to unleash the bull in the china shop, minimizing the damage while he gets her dirty work done without her getting her hands dirty.
d64c389f9ac9.t: Neferteri sedang jual mahal sedikit (cu doce, seperti kata orang Portugis): dia dapat rasa Huneo bukan orang yang mudah dia kawal. Dia berubah fikiran dalam Buku 7, sebaik dia belajar cara melepaskan lembu jantan di kedai pinggan mangkuk, meminimumkan kerosakan sementara lelaki itu membuat kerja kotornya tanpa dia mengotorkan tangannya sendiri.

d6c38c4309a7.en: Huneo launches into a long speech, until the crowd cuts him off: "Sanbi shit! Are you gonna talk all day or what? I got a fish to gut!" He skips several pages. "Thank you all, and—and I hope to earn your trust." The crowd claps, erratically but energetically, not quite sure what to make of this uptight Forway lookalike.
d6c38c4309a7.t: Huneo memulakan ucapan panjang, sehingga orang ramai memotongnya: “Demi jiwa tua Sanbi! Kau nak bercakap sepanjang hari ke apa? Aku ada ikan nak disiang!” Dia melangkau beberapa muka surat. “Terima kasih semua, dan—dan saya harap dapat meraih kepercayaan kalian.” Orang ramai bertepuk tangan, tidak menentu tetapi bersemangat, tidak begitu pasti apa nak dibuat dengan pelanduk dua serupa Forway yang kaku ini.

dbbe2bf82bb6.en: "Going by the contract alone, you're delivering double the minimum required. But this is no longer about our contract; it's about your relationship with Harry."
dbbe2bf82bb6.t: “Berdasarkan kontrak semata-mata, anakanda menyerahkan dua kali ganda jumlah minimum yang diperlukan. Tetapi ini bukan lagi tentang kontrak kita; ini tentang hubungan anakanda dengan Harry.”

dbc1ac158132.en: Eiri comes in and closes the door. "Are you guys abusing Sora?" Itanema: "C'mon now. This is your chance." Sora shakes her head into the pillow. "What's this all about?" "Argh. I guess I'll have to be the villain, then—I don't want this anymore. You're—"
dbc1ac158132.t: Eiri masuk dan menutup pintu. “Korang buli Sora ke?” Itanema: “Sudahlah. Ini peluang kau.” Sora menggeleng ke dalam bantal. “Apa semua ni?” “Argh. Rasanya aku kena jadi orang jahat, kalau macam tu—aku tak nak lagi semua ni. Kau—”

dbea584ae58e.en: Harry #8-B stumbles onto an abandoned shack

de0da974186f.en: Eiri asks for a day off to see Coema off. Neferteri can't stand hearing the name; she grips her badge and tells Eiri not to bring Coema here.
de0da974186f.t: Eiri meminta cuti sehari untuk menghantar Coema pergi. Neferteri tidak tahan mendengar nama itu; dia menggenggam lencananya dan memberitahu Eiri jangan bawa Coema ke sini.

debe7caede34.en: Harry #7-A eats a fruit the Bagarisas scream at him about
debe7caede34.t: Harry #7-A memakan buah yang membuat Bagarisa menjerit kepadanya

e04d41fced19.en: Aurora clears her throat. "Princesses?" They let go and sit down in unison, covered in a blanket of shame, looking away from each other. "Princess Eori, you were so busy with your nari gels that you never noticed Maiara's accomplishments in Homeegg. She's the glue that holds the Sanbi Kingdom team together."
e04d41fced19.t: Aurora berdehem. “Tuan-tuan Puteri?” Mereka melepaskan dan duduk serentak, diselubungi selimut malu, memandang ke arah lain. “Puteri Eori, tuan puteri terlalu sibuk dengan nari gel sampai tak pernah perasan pencapaian Maiara dalam Homeegg. Dialah gam yang menyatukan pasukan Kerajaan Sanbi.”

e53ea5c1b0bf.en: "Princess—daughter Eori. My daughter Eori. When I said Harry would be under your care, I meant using him as a tool to further our scientific knowledge, and our kingdom into the future."
e53ea5c1b0bf.t: “Tuan Puteri—anakanda Eori. Anakanda beta, Eori. Bila beta kata Harry akan di bawah jagaan anakanda, beta maksudkan menggunakannya sebagai alat untuk memajukan ilmu sains kita, dan kerajaan kita ke masa depan.”

e6ade5f6b103.en: Shady Black Magina riders on Eguas
e6ade5f6b103.t: Penunggang Black Magina yang mencurigakan di atas Egua

e6c11a250c86.en: Nina comes in holding a contract, smiling ear to ear, climbs onto a chair and, chest puffed out, unrolls it, trying to sound like a guard reading a sentence: "With the afore—mentioned clause—sules, Queen Neferteri shall terminate the contract, and the research funding."
e6c11a250c86.t: Nina masuk memegang sebuah kontrak, tersenyum lebar, memanjat ke atas kerusi dan, dengan dada membusung, membuka gulungannya, cuba berbunyi seperti pengawal membaca hukuman: “Dengan fa—sal-fasal yang ter—sebut di atas, Permaisuri Neferteri akan menamatkan kontrak, dan dana penyelidikan.”

e7964a37e572.en: Kibe and Huneo at the ceremony
e7964a37e572.t: Kibe dan Huneo di upacara itu

e82a7387c182.en: Eiri pets Sora's head. I guess love does make people do all kinds of crazy shit— She stops in her tracks, remembering how pushy Neferteri was about getting Harry to sign the contract, and how much she put on the search quest. Did the Queen already know Eori loved Harry? But then why— "Oh crap! Harry and Eori were having a love affair this whole time!"
e82a7387c182.t: Eiri mengusap kepala Sora. Rasanya cinta memang buat orang buat macam-macam benda gila— Dia berhenti melangkah, teringat betapa memaksanya Neferteri supaya Harry menandatangani kontrak, dan berapa banyak yang dia letak untuk misi pencarian itu. Permaisuri dah tahu ke Eori cintakan Harry? Tapi kalau macam tu kenapa— “Alamak! Harry dan Eori bercinta selama ni!”

e85ac8f4c504.en: Harry #7-A shelters at the foot of a big tree as night and rain set in
e85ac8f4c504.t: Harry #7-A berlindung di kaki sebatang pokok besar ketika malam dan hujan tiba

e88037789ba9.en: Eori, alone in a room, tries to free herself
e88037789ba9.t: Eori, seorang diri dalam bilik, cuba melepaskan diri

e93b0d7f2059.en: She also wants them to look into Arukia's disappearance: the more she thinks about it, the more intertwined Arukia's actions seem. But they're to put their own safety above hers, since nobody knows what Arukia, or whoever controls her, really is.
e93b0d7f2059.t: Dia juga mahu mereka menyiasat kehilangan Arukia: semakin dia memikirkannya, semakin berkait tindakan Arukia nampaknya. Tetapi mereka perlu meletakkan keselamatan sendiri di atas keselamatannya, kerana tiada siapa tahu apa sebenarnya Arukia, atau sesiapa yang mengawalnya.

ea00dec5e74b.en: Ukim, the new maid who came after Arukia left, and the curious type, digs deeper: "Did Eori really say that? That's so sweet!" Sora shakes her head. "There's something wrong! I know it!" Itanema: "You guys only noticed now?" Everyone stops. "Why didn't you say anything?" "'Cause it wouldn't really change anything. Just connect the dots. It's that easy."
ea00dec5e74b.t: Ukim, pembantu rumah baharu yang datang selepas Arukia pergi, dan jenis yang ingin tahu, mengorek lebih dalam: “Eori betul-betul cakap macam tu? Sweetnya!” Sora menggeleng. “Ada yang tak kena! Aku tahu!” Itanema: “Korang baru perasan sekarang?” Semua orang terhenti. “Kenapa kau tak cakap apa-apa?” “Sebab tak ubah apa pun sebenarnya. Sambungkan saja titik-titiknya. Senang je.”

ea0297bad0d1.en: Eori jumps up. "I NEVER SAID I LOVED HIM!" The guards step forward; she clenches her fists and sits back down, holding back a sea of emotions. Neferteri raises a hand, the guards step back, and she lets the awkward silence thicken.
ea0297bad0d1.t: Eori melompat bangun. “AKU TAK PERNAH CAKAP AKU CINTAKAN DIA!” Pengawal melangkah ke depan; dia menggenggam penumbuk dan duduk semula, menahan lautan emosi. Neferteri mengangkat tangan, pengawal berundur, dan dia membiarkan kesunyian yang janggal itu semakin tebal.

eb16ea3684af.en: Sora and Eiri, out with the guards, hear Eori scream
eb16ea3684af.t: Sora dan Eiri, keluar bersama pengawal, mendengar Eori menjerit

ef6d38fe423f.en: A hoarse voice: "I like 'em tight!" Thunder roars across the sky.
ef6d38fe423f.t: Suara serak: “Aku suka yang ketat!” Guruh berdentum di langit.

efbf557378a1.en: Sora and Aurora try to picture the dots and connect them, and can't. Itanema puts a hand to her mouth. "The walls say there's a love triangle between Arukia, Eori and Harry, and Harry dumped them both and disappeared with someone else." Aurora gasps and drops her tea; Sora is stuck in sheer disbelief. It clicks: all the time those three spent away from the castle, out of the public eye.
efbf557378a1.t: Sora dan Aurora cuba membayangkan titik-titik itu dan menyambungkannya, dan tidak boleh. Itanema menekup mulut. “Dinding-dinding cakap ada cinta tiga segi antara Arukia, Eori dan Harry, dan Harry tinggalkan kedua-duanya dan hilang dengan orang lain.” Aurora tersentak dan menjatuhkan tehnya; Sora terperangkap dalam rasa tidak percaya. Ia masuk akal: semua masa yang dihabiskan bertiga jauh dari istana, jauh dari mata umum.

f02af4af8c4c.en: "I gave you a fuckload of new nari gel! What about it?"
f02af4af8c4c.t: “Aku dah bagi bonda banyak gila nari gel baharu! Apa masalahnya?”

f213ceca3bf9.en: Near sundown, the Bagarisas find someone's remains not far from the shack and start chewing on them. Harry realizes it was a person and tells them to stop. The clothes are an older woman's. He calls inside, but no one answers.
f213ceca3bf9.t: Menjelang senja, Bagarisa menjumpai mayat seseorang tidak jauh dari pondok itu dan mula mengunyahnya. Harry sedar itu dulunya seorang manusia dan menyuruh mereka berhenti. Pakaiannya milik seorang wanita yang lebih tua. Dia memanggil ke dalam, tetapi tiada siapa menjawab.

f71b004edf0a.en: Katsuki watches from the barred window

f9fdf9fee229.t: Harry #8-A memasak di tepi unggun api

fa3226bf4e4c.en: Chunks of meat and fur on a makeshift spit, a bloodied stone on the side. Disgusted, he eats it anyway, spitting out fur. The Bagarisas want some, so he gives them all of it, and they clean their plate.
fa3226bf4e4c.t: Ketulan daging dan bulu di atas pemanggang buatan sendiri, batu berlumuran darah di tepi. Jijik, dia makan juga, meludah keluar bulu. Bagarisa mahu sedikit, jadi dia beri semuanya kepada mereka, dan mereka licinkan pinggan.

fa747c82ad01.en: Neferteri with Morika, Namia and Posaqui
fa747c82ad01.t: Neferteri bersama Morika, Namia dan Posaqui

fb32b202048c.en: "HAAARRRRYYY!!!! I LLLLOOOOOVVEEE YOOOUU!" echoes through the bustling city night, and the city goes quiet as everyone tries to figure out what just happened.
fb32b202048c.t: “HAAARRRRYYY!!!! AKU CIIIINNNTAAAKAAAN KAAAUUU!” bergema di seluruh malam bandar yang sibuk, dan bandar itu senyap ketika semua orang cuba memahami apa yang baru berlaku.
